message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather. The average high is about **68 °F (≈20 °C)**, while the average low drops to roughly **48 °F (≈9 °C)**. If you’re looking at a mean daily temperature, it’s usually around **58 °F (≈14 °C)**. These figures can vary slightly from year to year, but overall December is one of the cooler months in LA, though still relatively temperate compared to many other U.S. cities.
